This is what MEL builds for M1-M5. Minimum viable, maximum impact. Every command should work within seconds on mobile.
Bot Architecture
Single Python file (< 400 lines) using python-telegram-bot v20+
Connects to existing Supabase project (qnnpjhlxljtqyigedwkb) via REST API
Deployed on Railway (already your infra) — zero new accounts needed
Whisper API (OpenAI or faster: faster-whisper local) for M4 voice transcription
No database changes to Trinity Symphony core — reads existing tables, writes only to new approval_queue table
New Supabase Table: approval_queue

CREATE TABLE approval_queue ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, agent_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_type TEXT NOT NULL, output_summary TEXT NOT NULL, full_output JSONB, rep_id_score FLOAT, wsce_score FLOAT, cost_saved FLOAT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', -- pending | approved | rejected | redirected redirect_note TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ, resolved_by TEXT );
